code_format: timesaver.gg / wowsims talents string: trees in the order of "trees", joined with "-"; within a tree one digit (the rank) per talent in codeOrder (row by row, left to right); trailing zeros of each tree and trailing dashes are dropped. Example:

rules.tier: a talent in row N (1-based) needs 5 x (N-1) points in its tree; client TraitCond SpentAmountRequired matches 5 x (N-1) for all 467 nodes. Whether points in the gated row itself count (Method.gg planner) or only rows above (wowsims) is not settled by the client data.
rules.prereq: prerequisite at its maximum rank (wowsims ui/sim/talents/broken_talents.ts rule; client TraitEdge Type 2/3 gives the link, not the rank)
